task: Na webovej stránke nájdi stránku s kontaktnými údajmi. Otvor ju a vypíš e-mailovú adresu a telefónne číslo na zákaznícku podporu alebo reklamácie tovaru.

goalSpec.goal: Find the contact page, open it, and then extract the email address and phone number for customer support or product complaints.
successCriteria: The cookie consent overlay is no longer present.
The agent has navigated to the contact page.
The agent has identified and outputted the email address for customer support/complaints.
The agent has identified and outputted the phone number for customer support/complaints.
goalSpec.stopCondition: Both the email address and phone number for customer support/complaints have been identified and outputted.
assumptions: The contact information for customer support or product complaints will be available on the contact page or clearly visible on the website.
The email address and phone number visible at the top of the initial page are suitable for customer support/complaints if no specific ones are found on the contact page.

subtasks.title: Accept the cookie consent to remove the overlay.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cookie consent overlay is no longer present.

subtasks.title: Navigate to the contact page using the 'Kontakt' link.
subtasks.doneWhen: The page URL indicates the contact page (e.g., contains '/kontakt') and the page content is related to contact information.

subtasks.title: Extract the email address and phone number for customer support or product complaints from the contact page.
subtasks.doneWhen: The email address and phone number are clearly identified and ready to be reported.

finalVerdict: Stránka s kontaktnými údajmi je otvorená. E-mailová adresa je info@metalindustrial.sk. Telefónne číslo je +421 919 457 815.
